plan.describe:
Plan revision 0, tier compiled: one-off evaluation (phase 1b)
  mode = compiled  (one-off evaluation: compiled model, no CUDA graphs (SPEC §7.4))
  superset = O Ti Sr  (declared (species=), equal to the structure's)
  force_precision = float32  (the ForceField's precision (SPEC §7.1, §9.2))
  software.oeq = on  (openequivariance is installed (its extension is built when the hybrid model is loaded))
  software.triton = on  (triton 3.8.0 is importable)
  software.nvrtc = on  (NVRTC 13.0 loads through cuda.bindings)
  software.fused_cueq = on  (cuequivariance_ops_torch imports)
  software.mace_imported_first = none  (modules imported before FastMACE could prepare the OEq runtime)
  allow_naive_cueq = off  (not needed: no naive cuEq kernel)
  EngineConfig.dynamic_edges = on  (exact edge counts: the edge dimension is dynamic from the first call, so a new edge count does not compile again (2-T13))
  tier = compiled  (one-off evaluation: compiled model, exact edge counts, no CUDA graphs)
  workload = ok  (135 atoms, 3D PBC, no constraints)
  hardware = NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB  (compute capability 8.0, 79.3 GiB (recorded only))
  EngineConfig.backend = hybrid  (auto: OpenEquivariance builds and the process allows it (SPEC §9.4))
  PrecisionConfig.dtype = float32  (requested 'float32': hybrid backend)
  EngineConfig.cueq_conv_fusion = off  (auto (on_for_plain_cueq_unless_reproducible): not applicable: the hybrid fuses its OEq convolution anyway (the research engine records None))
  RewriteConfig.factor_species = off  (auto (on_for_hybrid_graph_engine_if_model_supports): stage 1: hybrid backend; stage 2: off, not supported by the model (interactions ['RealAgnosticDensityInteractionBlock', 'RealAgnosticDensityResidualInteractionBlock'] are not ('RealAgnosticResidualNonLinearInteractionBlock',)))
  RewriteConfig.fold_cutoff = off  (auto (on_with_factor_species_if_model_supports): stage 1: on (with factor_species); stage 2: off, not supported by the model (interactions ['RealAgnosticDensityInteractionBlock', 'RealAgnosticDensityResidualInteractionBlock'] are not ('RealAgnosticResidualNonLinearInteractionBlock',)))
  RewriteConfig.density_first = off  (auto (on_with_fold_cutoff_if_model_supports): stage 1: on (with fold_cutoff); stage 2: off, not supported by the model (interactions ['RealAgnosticDensityInteractionBlock', 'RealAgnosticDensityResidualInteractionBlock'] are not ('RealAgnosticResidualNonLinearInteractionBlock',)))
  RewriteConfig.reassociate_first = on  (auto (on_with_stage1_fold_cutoff_if_model_supports): stage 1: on (with fold_cutoff); stage 2: supported (ok (GENERIC_REASSOCIATE)))
  RewriteConfig.joint_radial_input = off  (auto (on_with_fold_cutoff_if_model_supports): stage 1: on (with fold_cutoff); stage 2: off, not supported by the model (interactions ['RealAgnosticDensityInteractionBlock', 'RealAgnosticDensityResidualInteractionBlock'] are not ('RealAgnosticResidualNonLinearInteractionBlock',)))
  RewriteConfig.fused_folded_backward = on  (auto (on_with_stage1_fold_cutoff_if_model_supports): stage 1: on (with fold_cutoff); stage 2: supported (ok))
  RewriteConfig.folded_backward_tiles = off  (auto (on_with_fused_folded_backward): stage 1: on (with fused_folded_backward); stage 2: off, not supported by the model (interactions ['RealAgnosticDensityInteractionBlock', 'RealAgnosticDensityResidualInteractionBlock'] are not ('RealAgnosticResidualNonLinearInteractionBlock',)))
  RewriteConfig.segmented_first_sum = on  (auto (on_with_reassociate_first_and_sort_receivers): stage 1: on (with reassociate_first and sort_receivers); stage 2: supported (ok (GENERIC_REASSOCIATE)))
  RewriteConfig.fused_radial_hidden = off  (auto (never_automatic): off: only an explicit 'on' enables it (no measured gain))
  RewriteConfig.direct_node_feats = off  (auto (never_automatic): off: only an explicit 'on' enables it (OPT3-T05, opt-in))
  RewriteConfig.folded_constants = off  (auto (never_automatic): off: only an explicit 'on' enables it (OPT3-T05, opt-in))
  RewriteConfig.streaming_conv = on  (auto (on_for_hybrid_with_stage1_fold_cutoff_and_sort_receivers_if_model_supports): stage 1: on (with the hybrid backend, fold_cutoff (stage 1) and sort_receivers (a hard requirement: streaming kernels on unsorted edges give wrong results)); stage 2: supported (ok))
  RewriteConfig.chunked_conv_backward = on  (auto (on_with_streaming_conv_and_fused_folded_backward): stage 1: on (with streaming_conv and fused_folded_backward); stage 2: supported (ok (generic folded path)); stage 2: on as the carrier of wprime_backward, whose backward never chunks, decision 66 (NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB))
  RewriteConfig.fused_folded_forward = on  (auto (on_for_mh1_float32_unless_reproducible_and_for_omat0_with_wprime_on_decision_66_gpus): stage 1: on (with chunked_conv_backward); stage 2: supported (ok (generic folded path)); stage 2: on with wprime_backward, omat0-medium on a measured GPU, decision 66 (NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB))
  RewriteConfig.radial_tables = on  (auto (on_with_fold_cutoff_unless_reproducible): stage 1: on (with fold_cutoff); stage 2: supported (ok (generic radial tables)); stage 2: on, generic radial tables on a measured GPU, decision 66 (NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB))
  RewriteConfig.w_tables = off  (auto (on_for_mh1_float64_on_measured_gpus_decision_65): stage 1: on (with fold_cutoff); stage 2: off, not supported by the model (interactions ['RealAgnosticDensityInteractionBlock', 'RealAgnosticDensityResidualInteractionBlock'] are not ('RealAgnosticResidualNonLinearInteractionBlock',)))
  RewriteConfig.wprime_backward = on  (auto (on_for_mh1_and_omat0_float32_unless_reproducible_on_decision_66_gpus): stage 1: on (with fold_cutoff); stage 2: supported (ok (generic radial tables)); stage 2: on, omat0-medium (generic) on a measured GPU, decision 66 (NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB))
  RewriteConfig.recompute_conv_weights = off  (auto (on_by_rule_12_when_the_plan_does_not_fit_without_it): off: on only when memory would not be enough without it: rule 12 for a cell that cannot fit, or a rebuild after an out-of-memory error at build or capture (CAP-T07))
  RewriteConfig.recompute_first_table = off  (auto (on_by_rule_12_when_the_plan_does_not_fit_with_recompute_conv_weights): off: on only when memory would not be enough with recompute_conv_weights on: rule 12 for a cell that cannot fit, or a rebuild after an out-of-memory error at build or capture (rebuild-a))
  RewriteConfig.recompute_first_layer = off  (auto (on_by_rule_12_when_the_plan_does_not_fit_with_recompute_first_table): off: on only when memory would not be enough with recompute_first_table on: rule 12 for a cell that cannot fit, or a rebuild after an out-of-memory error at build or capture (results/rung-b-20261109))
  RewriteConfig.block_linear = on  (auto (on_for_hybrid_graph_engine): stage 1: hybrid backend)
  RewriteConfig.grouped_linear = on  (auto (on_with_block_linear): stage 1: on (with block_linear))
  RewriteConfig.merged_residual = on  (auto (on_with_block_linear): stage 1: on (with block_linear))
  RewriteConfig.gated_rows = off  (auto (on_with_merged_residual): stage 1: on (with merged_residual); stage 2: off, not supported by the model (interactions ['RealAgnosticDensityInteractionBlock', 'RealAgnosticDensityResidualInteractionBlock'] are not ('RealAgnosticResidualNonLinearInteractionBlock',)))
  RewriteConfig.segment_gemm = off  (auto (on_with_gated_rows_float32_unless_reproducible): stage 1: on (with gated_rows); stage 2: off, not supported by the model (interactions ['RealAgnosticDensityInteractionBlock', 'RealAgnosticDensityResidualInteractionBlock'] are not ('RealAgnosticResidualNonLinearInteractionBlock',)))
  RewriteConfig.gate_epilogue = off  (auto (on_with_segment_gemm_for_mh1_on_decision_66_gpus): stage 1: on (with segment_gemm); stage 2: off, not supported by the model (interactions ['RealAgnosticDensityInteractionBlock', 'RealAgnosticDensityResidualInteractionBlock'] are not ('RealAgnosticResidualNonLinearInteractionBlock',)))
  RewriteConfig.recompute_node_segments = off  (auto (on_by_rule_12_when_the_plan_does_not_fit_with_recompute_conv_weights): off: on only when memory would not be enough with recompute_conv_weights on: rule 12 for a cell that cannot fit, or a rebuild after an out-of-memory error at build or capture (CAP-T08))
  RewriteConfig.recompute_node_region = off  (auto (on_by_rule_12_when_the_plan_does_not_fit_with_recompute_node_segments): off: on only when memory would not be enough with recompute_node_segments on: rule 12 for a cell that cannot fit, or a rebuild after an out-of-memory error at build or capture (ninth list item 2))
  RewriteConfig.grouped_launch = off  (auto (on_with_block_linear_float32_unless_reproducible_for_generic_mace_family_and_mh1_on_decision_66_gpus): stage 1: on (with block_linear); stage 2: off, tf32x3_gemms reroutes the block products)
  RewriteConfig.species_skip = on  (auto (on_with_graph_engine_if_model_supports): stage 1: graph engine, any backend; stage 2: supported (ok))
  RewriteConfig.single_graph_strain = on  (auto (on): acts where stress is computed (NPT))
  RewriteConfig.species_tables = off  (auto (on_unless_reproducible_if_model_supports): stage 1: graph engine, any backend; stage 2: off, not supported by the model (the first interaction is not ('RealAgnosticResidualNonLinearInteractionBlock',)))
  RewriteConfig.fold_readout_tail = off  (auto (on_with_block_linear_unless_reproducible_if_model_supports): stage 1: on (with block_linear); stage 2: off, not supported by the model (the last interaction is not ('RealAgnosticResidualNonLinearInteractionBlock',) (its skip_tp is element-dependent)))
  RewriteConfig.fold_product_linear = on  (auto (on_with_species_tables_and_block_linear_if_model_supports): stage 1: on (with block_linear and species_tables (generic: species_skip)); stage 2: supported (ok (generic: no skip term in the first product)); stage 2: on, generic fold on a measured GPU, decision 66 (NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB))
  RewriteConfig.species_residual = off  (auto (never_automatic): off: only an explicit 'on' enables it (fp32 profile, opt-in))
  RewriteConfig.combo_kernels = off  (auto (never_automatic): off: only an explicit 'on' enables it (opt-in until its A/B on both GPUs))
  RewriteConfig.save_transcendentals = off  (auto (on_for_mh1_float64_on_measured_gpus_decision_65): transcendental ops saved for the backward, not recomputed (ideas-20261027 D3); off: float32 plan, decision 65)
  RewriteConfig.tf32x3_gemms = on  (auto (on_for_mh1_and_omat0_float32_unless_reproducible_on_decision_66_gpus): stage 1: on (with block_linear); stage 2: on, omat0-medium on a measured GPU, decision 66 (NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB))
  RewriteConfig.fx_e3nn_linear = off  (auto (on_for_hybrid_float32_unless_reproducible_for_qualified_polar1_checkpoints): stage 1: hybrid backend; stage 2: off, not a qualified POLAR-1 checkpoint, decision 58 (ScaleShiftMACE; qualified: polar1-s, polar1-m, polar1-l))
  RewriteConfig.polar_graph_sums = off  (auto (on_for_hybrid_float32_unless_reproducible_for_qualified_polar1_checkpoints): stage 1: hybrid backend; stage 2: off, not a qualified POLAR-1 checkpoint, decision 58 (ScaleShiftMACE; qualified: polar1-s, polar1-m, polar1-l))
  NeighbourConfig.sort_receivers = on  (auto (on_for_hybrid_graph_engine): hybrid backend)
  NeighbourConfig.gpu_neighbour_list = on  (auto (on_with_graph_engine): graph engine)
  EngineConfig.fp64_emulation = off  (auto (on_for_float64_cuda_with_reduced_rate_fp64_unless_reproducible): float32 plan: no float64 matrix products)
  EngineConfig.fp64_emulation_mantissa_bits = dynamic  (auto (dynamic_decision_65_d1_suspended_after_recapture_defect): no effect: fp64_emulation is off)
  RewriteConfig.inplace_block_linear = off  (not carried over in 1a (SPEC §6.2: opt-in, slower))
  RewriteConfig.cueq_projected = on  (auto (on_with_tf32x3_gemms_on_listed_gpus_unless_model_excluded_decision_66): with tf32x3_gemms on a listed GPU, decision 66 (NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB))
  RewriteConfig.sc_generated = on  (auto (on_with_tf32x3_gemms_on_listed_gpus_decision_66): with tf32x3_gemms on a listed GPU, decision 66 (NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB))
  RewriteConfig.polar_uvu = on  (no effect: not a PolarMACE model)
  PolarConfig.kspace_headroom = n/a  (auto (variable_cell_0_1_else_0): not a PolarMACE model, no long range)
  EngineConfig.expandable_segments = on  (auto (on_for_torch_2_14_unless_alloc_conf_set): PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True before the first CUDA allocation)
  EngineConfig.compile_mode = default  (main.py's --compile-mode)
  EngineConfig.speculative_graph = off  (one-off evaluation: no graph engine)
  EngineConfig.pipelined = off  (one-off evaluation: no graph engine)
  EngineConfig.async_output = off  (one-off evaluation: no graph engine)
  capture = off  (one-off evaluation: no CUDA graphs)
  integrator = none  (one-off evaluation)
  compute_stress = on  (one-off evaluation: stress for any cell (fm.calc, cell filters))
  EngineConfig.force_graphs = keep  (auto (fit_when_capturing_on_cuda_else_keep): no CUDA graphs)
  EngineConfig.memory_probe = off  (auto (near_limit_for_md_on_cuda): no MD on CUDA: nothing to probe)
  NeighbourConfig.edge_index_int32 = on  (auto (on_for_decision_66_gpus): gate and A/B passed on this GPU)
  NeighbourConfig.skin = 0.3 A  (auto (rule_11_skin_from_workload): phase 1a's skin: rule 11 sizes only MC and species-change workloads)
  NeighbourConfig.headroom = fixed  (auto (rule_11_headroom_from_workload): capacity_headroom 1.15 and edge_bucket_fraction as given)
  NeighbourConfig.d3_skin = unused  (auto (rule_11_d3_skin_from_workload): no D3 list; 1 A, the floor)
  EngineConfig.recapture_budget = 64  (auto (recapture_budget_from_workload): the graph variant cap (64): past it the run warns, records and the report recommends the compiled tier (3-T04))
  PrecisionConfig.mc_energy = float32  (auto (force_precision_if_move_energy_gate_passes_else_float64): the force precision: no MC moves, no MC energies)
  requested: PrecisionConfig.dtype=float32

auto_options_off.fold_readout_tail: the last interaction is not ('RealAgnosticResidualNonLinearInteractionBlock',) (its skip_tp is element-dependent)
auto_options_off.fx_e3nn_linear: not a qualified POLAR-1 checkpoint, decision 58 (ScaleShiftMACE; qualified: polar1-s, polar1-m, polar1-l)
auto_options_off.polar_graph_sums: not a qualified POLAR-1 checkpoint, decision 58 (ScaleShiftMACE; qualified: polar1-s, polar1-m, polar1-l)
